verdict: Spend is high, lead volume is tiny — the funnel is leaking before conversion.
diagnosis: Spend of $7,003 produced only 2 leads at $12 cost per lead, with just 9 purchases returning $5,897.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads from $7,003 spend
signals.detail: Lead volume is dangerously low for the budget deployed this period. The account is generating clicks that do not convert.

signals.headline: 9 purchases returned $5,897 in revenue
signals.detail: Ad spend exceeded revenue by roughly $1,100 this period. The return on ad spend of 0.84 is below breakeven.

signals.headline: 4,387 clicks but 139 landing page views
signals.detail: Only 3% of clicks reach the landing page. Tracking, redirect, or page speed issues are likely killing the funnel.

signals.headline: Cost per click climbed to $2.61
signals.detail: Latest cost per click is above the period average of $2.08. Auction pressure on 'life alert' keywords is rising.

signals.headline: Just 2 phone call clicks captured
signals.detail: For a call-focused campaign, phone engagement is nearly zero. Call tracking or ad extensions may be misconfigured.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: <cite index="4-2">The healthcare average is $66.02 per lead from a $5.64 cost per click and an 8.09% conversion rate</cite>. Liferun's $12 cost per lead looks strong, but only 2 leads were captured this period.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: <cite index="11-8,11-9,11-10">The 2026 market is built around independence, speed, and prevention, driven by safety concerns, tech breakthroughs, and a rapidly aging population</cite>. Fall season typically lifts caregiver purchase intent.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Wearables and Apple Watch pressure category
competitor.body: <cite index="11-18,11-19">In 2026, lighter hardware, longer battery, fall detection, and 24/7 GPS are baseline expectations, shifting away from pendant systems</cite>. Apple Watch competes with no monthly fee.

recommendations.title: Audit the click-to-landing-page gap this week
recommendations.detail: Only 139 of 4,387 clicks reached the page. Consider checking redirects, mobile load speed, and conversion tracking before adding more budget.

recommendations.title: Test call extensions and click-to-call ads
recommendations.detail: This is a call campaign with 2 phone clicks. Worth exploring call-only ad formats and verifying the (800) 421-3366 tracking works.

recommendations.title: Refine retargeting audience beyond video viewers
recommendations.detail: Consider testing caregiver and adult-child audiences alongside the current 50% video view segment. Aging-parent buyers often research on behalf of seniors.
